Yest.why: Makes pressure-cure equipment used in the HBM underfill process plus thermal/annealing tools; its semiconductor equipment sales (64% of standalone H1 2026 sales) go to Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, so HBM packaging capacity additions drive its orders.
Yest.evidence: Yest half-year report (filed 08-14-2026): pressure cure is used in the HBM underfill process (void removal and curing); main products are built for Samsung Electronics' semiconductor production processes, and orders continue from SK Hynix and Amkor.

players.product: Pressure-cure equipment for HBM underfill (void removal and curing), high-pressure annealing and furnaces

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report: H1 2026 consolidated revenue KRW 69,447,996,151 (H1 2025: KRW 48,852,188,860) and operating profit KRW 7,628,267,384 (H1 2025: KRW 5,065,053,944); Q2 2026 revenue KRW 41,945,739,918 (Q2 2025: KRW 23,767,355,831) and Q2 operating profit KRW 4,565,708,670 (Q2 2025: KRW 2,847,502,470); H1 net income KRW 5,100,392,021 (H1 2025: net loss KRW 2,846,560,341)
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 revenue KRW 69,447,996,151; operating profit KRW 7,628,267,384

quarterly_data.signal: Products: pressure-cure equipment used in the HBM underfill process (void removal and curing); high-pressure annealing with high-pressure hydrogen (deuterium) to cure interface defects in front-end processes; furnaces for wafer cleaning and ion stabilization; plus autoclaves and laminators for OLED. Company history: new HBM equipment production began in December 2023, and in December 2025 it won an order for a 125-wafer HPA (high-pressure annealing) tool from a memory customer. Standalone H1 2026 sales: semiconductor equipment KRW 37,178M (64%), display equipment KRW 20,596M (36%); semiconductor/display equipment 83.19% of consolidated sales
quarterly_data.figure: semiconductor equipment KRW 37,178M (64% of standalone sales)

quarterly_data.signal: Customers: Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix and Samsung Display; orders also continue to come from SK Hynix and Amkor, and the company is expanding to local foundry and memory makers in Taiwan, Japan and China. Customers above 10% of consolidated H1 2026 revenue (names not disclosed): A KRW 30,890,758 thousand (affiliates combined; H1 2025: KRW 14,907,382 thousand), B KRW 9,758,000 thousand, C KRW 9,471,300 thousand, D KRW 6,998,358 thousand, E KRW 4,972,145 thousand. US revenue KRW 2,922,609 thousand (H1 2025: KRW 396,734 thousand)
quarterly_data.counterparty: Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix, Samsung Display, Amkor; undisclosed Customers A-E

quarterly_data.signal: Order backlog is not disclosed at customers' request; transaction price allocated to partially unsatisfied contracts KRW 4,654,750 thousand, all expected to be recognized in the next reporting period; advances received on equipment supply contracts KRW 3,729,025 thousand (end-2025: KRW 469,000 thousand); contract assets KRW 1,834,650 thousand

Capex and R&D: H1 2026 consolidated PP&E additions KRW 5,449,022 thousand, mostly construction in progress (KRW 5,161,691 thousand); R&D KRW 4,783,036 thousand (8.26% of sales). Litigation: HPSP has filed two patent-infringement injunction suits against the company (KRW 100,000,000 each), pending at first instance at the Seoul Central District Court
quarterly_data.figure: construction in progress additions KRW 5,161,691 thousand

connects_to.relationship: Thermal-process, temperature-control and inspection equipment for semiconductor lines

contracts.signal: Half-year report: Yest's main products are thermal-processing, temperature-control and inspection equipment designed to the specifications of Samsung Electronics' semiconductor production processes; Samsung Electronics is named among its major customers
Half-year report: orders continue to be received from SK Hynix; SK Hynix is named among the company's customers
Half-year report: orders continue to be received from Amkor in the domestic market
